capabilities: Hide the whole interface for a full-screen focus view
Dim text outside the current paragraph or line
Keep the cursor line centered with typewriter scrolling
Switch page themes, fonts and text size from a dock menu
Play recorded mechanical keyboard sounds while typing
extras: Part of the Scribe of Lagash series of story-writing plugins; has no settings tab and never edits notes; spell check is always off in focus mode with no setting to change that; development accepts Ko-fi donations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hide the entire interface and dim or center surrounding text while writing.

relations.evidence: they are designed to complement each other and work best together
Session extras that pair with Goals and Stats, such as a timer
relations.plugin: Scribe of Lagash - Goals and Stats

summary: Distraction-free full-screen focus mode with typewriter scrolling, paragraph or line dimming, page themes and mechanical key sounds.
